# Self-Review Checklist: Team Work Predictability Suite

**Purpose**: Solo author review of requirement quality — completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability — before treating the spec pack as done. Does not verify implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**How to use (solo)**: Work the seven passes below in order. Check an item only when the written requirement is good enough to implement without a follow-up question. Park unresolved items in Notes with a decision: fix the spec, or accept as an explicit assumption.

---

## Pass 1 — Scope freeze

- [ ] CHK001 Are v1 in-scope surfaces limited to library + CLI, with HTTP/`serve`/OpenAPI runtime explicitly out of v1 (not merely omitted)? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Scope Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK002 Is prediction grain locked to epic/feature, with tracker issues and people excluded as prediction objects? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are child issues specified as factor/completion inputs only, never as `predict` rows? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the public-output ban on person-level slip, ranking, and performance scores stated as a MUST, not only a clarification? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK005 Are team-level and sprint-level figures specified as aggregations of epic predictions (and is “sprint figures” either defined or dropped)? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §US1, Gap]

## Pass 2 — Clarifications landed in FRs

- [ ] CHK006 Is “team-committed deadline = first changelog due date, else current due + `deadline_source`” restated as a functional requirement, not only a clarification and US4 scenario? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-016, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK007 Are all three `epic_done` modes (`own` | `children` | `own_then_children`) and the default named in requirements, including what happens when `own` has no resolution? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is `evaluate` specified as walk-forward only, forbidden from reading or mutating the serving artifact, with ranking metric p90 pinball and Brier tie-break? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Spec §US6]
- [ ] CHK009 Is `predict` specified to use the last successful `train` (activate-by-default) and to accept file input **or** open epics from the store? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK010 Are v1 backend names (`empirical_bayes`, `quantile_catboost`, `quantile_lightgbm`) required in the spec independently of the plan? [Traceability, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-019]

## Pass 3 — Completeness of core behaviors

- [ ] CHK011 Is slip defined as signed (actual − committed) with a configured unit and a default of working days? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 Are atomic outputs (expected slip, p50, p90, extra quantiles via config, P(on-time)) fully enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Are built-in factors named, independently configurable, and specified for directional effect (vacation raises slip; foreign blockers lower on-time)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK014 Is `cross_team_deps` specified as epic links ∪ child-link rollup with `team_id` dedupe, including circular/missing-link degradation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are Jira and YouTrack adapters required to read due-date changelog, with CI fixtures (no live APIs) as the default test path? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Are third-party adapters and factors required via plugin entry points without core source changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §US3-4]
- [ ] CHK017 Is continued training specified as full refit from SQLite completed-epic history, with activate-by-default of the new artifact? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §US5]
- [ ] CHK018 Are ingest reporting, upsert identity `(tracker, external_id)`, and skip/invalid counting specified for unmapped team and no-deadline rows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Spec §US4]

## Pass 4 — Clarity and defaults

- [ ] CHK019 Is `min_history` given a default (or an explicit “config-only, no default”) in the spec, not only in [factor-protocol.md](../contracts/factor-protocol.md) (`20`)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-004, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Is shrinkage (`w = n/(n+k)`) a specified requirement, or only an implementation detail left to research/plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, Spec §US5]
- [ ] CHK021 Is `allow_partial` on tracker fetch a named config requirement (default, when partial pages may be treated as full history) or only an edge-case mention? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Is SC-002’s “documented margin” quantified in the spec (numeric delta, fixture name, or pointer to the evaluation fixture)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK023 Are CLI/library structured-error requirements (non-zero exit, no traceback on stdout) present as FRs, not only US2 acceptance? [Completeness, Spec §US2, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the default SQLite path and `--db` override specified for both library and CLI? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Pass 5 — Consistency across artifacts

- [ ] CHK025 Do spec FRs, [data-model.md](../data-model.md), and [adapter-protocol.md](../contracts/adapter-protocol.md) agree on `deadline_source` values (`changelog` | `current_fallback`) and first-due-date rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK026 Do spec, data-model, and constitution agree that vacations affect the capacity **factor** and MUST NOT redefine slip (and that working-day slip MUST NOT double-count weekend/holiday overlap)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK027 Is FR-009’s optional `partial_fit` consistent with constitution VI (full refit) and the research decision that online `partial_fit` was rejected? [Conflict, Spec §FR-009, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK028 Does US2 “JSON file **or** store” match FR-014 “JSON/YAML **or** store”, and is dual `--file` plus `--status open` specified if the CLI contract unions them? [Conflict, Spec §US2, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK029 Is `cancelled` epic handling specified in the spec (data-model excludes from train) rather than only in [data-model.md](../data-model.md)? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the filed [openapi.yaml](../contracts/openapi.yaml) labeled v2-only so it cannot be read as a v1 requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §SC-006]

## Pass 6 — Scenario and edge coverage

- [ ] CHK031 Are open epics excluded from the supervised target but still eligible for `predict` (file or store)? [Coverage, Spec §US1, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 Is negative slip (early completion) specified as valid? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK033 Are changelog-unavailable, missing `team_id`, and no-deadline ingest outcomes specified without failing the whole batch? [Exception Flow, Spec §US4, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 Are tracker auth/rate-limit failures specified as typed abort (not silent partial success) unless `allow_partial`? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK035 Is extremely small-n behavior specified for `empirical_bayes` (must train) vs GBM extras (warn or refuse with a clear error)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK036 Are new-team cold-start (`cold_start=true`, global prior) and post-`min_history` refit specified as distinct outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Spec §US5, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK037 Are recovery/rollback requirements intentionally out of scope (local SQLite, no migration story), and is that stated? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Pass 7 — Acceptance quality and constitution fit

- [ ] CHK038 Can SC-001 (install to first prediction in under 15 minutes, no HTTP) be scored without extra interpretation? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK039 Can SC-003 (custom adapter protocol only) and SC-007 (re-ingest row growth ≤ 1%) be objectively verified from the spec text? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK040 Does SC-005 require walk-forward of Bayes plus at least one GBM on ≥ 1,000 completed epics **and** an unchanged active artifact? [Coverage, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK041 Are privacy (no person scores), library-first, CLI-as-v1-surface, fixture-only default tests, and SQLite/full-refit/epic-grain aligned with constitution I–VI rather than contradicted? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-018, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK042 Is `team_bias` required as default-on for GBM **and** `empirical_bayes` required as a first-class `evaluate` backend (bias not only a GBM feature)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Quality gates from the constitution (Ruff, format, mypy, pytest, pre-commit)
  apply to any implementation work this checklist covers; they are not optional.

### Suggested solo timing

| Pass | Focus | Time |
|------|--------|------|
| 1 | Scope freeze | 10–15 min |
| 2 | Clarifications → FRs | 10–15 min |
| 3 | Core behaviors | 15–20 min |
| 4 | Defaults and vague terms | 10–15 min |
| 5 | Spec vs data-model vs contracts | 15–20 min |
| 6 | Edges and exceptions | 10–15 min |
| 7 | Success criteria + constitution | 10 min |

Total: about 80–110 minutes. If an item fails, either amend the spec (or the matching artifact) or write the decision under Assumptions — do not leave it as a silent gap.

### Highest-risk items to start with if short on time

CHK005 (sprint aggregation), CHK019 (`min_history` default), CHK021 (`allow_partial`), CHK022 (SC-002 margin), CHK027 (`partial_fit` vs full refit), CHK028 (file vs YAML vs union flags), CHK029 (`cancelled`).
